description: EPCIS 2.0 TransformationEvent describing how inputs are transformed into outputs during a business process.

@context.description: Allowed shapes for an EPCIS 2.0 JSON-LD `@context`, anchored on the GS1 context root and optionally augmented with custom entries.

eventID.description: URI identifier of a specific EPCIS event (alias of id in JSON or XML).

certificationInfo.description: (Optional) CertificationDetails relevant for Objects, Places and/or Organizations mentioned in this Event.

eventTime.description: The date and time at which the EPCIS Capturing Applications asserts the event occurred.

eventTimeZoneOffset.description: The time zone offset in effect at the time and place the event occurred, expressed as an offset from UTC.

recordTime.description: (Optional) The date and time at which this event was recorded by an EPCIS Repository; ignored at capture and present on query results.

inputEPCList.description: (Optional) Unordered list of one or more EPCs identifying (at the instance level) objects that were inputs to the transformation.

inputQuantityList.description: (Optional) Unordered list of one or more QuantityElements identifying class-level inputs; may be omitted subject to the EPCIS quantity-list constraints.

outputEPCList.description: (Optional) Unordered list of one or more EPCs naming (at the instance level) objects that were outputs from the transformation.

outputQuantityList.description: (Optional) Unordered list of one or more QuantityElements identifying class-level outputs; may be omitted subject to the EPCIS quantity-list constraints.

transformationID.description: A unique identifier linking TransformationEvents; shared values connect inputs and outputs across those events.

bizStep.description: (Optional) The business step of which this event was a part.

disposition.description: (Optional) The business condition of the objects associated with the EPCs, presumed to hold true until contradicted by a subsequent event.

readPoint.description: (Optional) The read point at which the event took place.

bizLocation.description: (Optional) The business location where the objects associated with the EPCs may be found, until contradicted by a subsequent event.

bizTransactionList.description: An unordered list of business transactions that define the context of this event.

sourceList.description: (Optional) Unordered list of Source elements that provide context about the originating endpoint of a business transfer of which this event is a part.

destinationList.description: (Optional) Unordered list of Destination elements that provide context about the terminating endpoint of a business transfer of which this event is a part.

sensorElementList.description: (Optional) Connects event to one or more SensorElements.

ilmd.description: (Optional) Instance/Lot master data that describes the objects created during this event.
